task_objective: Check the actual file type, software compatibility and file integrity before attempting conversion.
constraints: Retain the original or another recoverable copy before any proposed conversion or other content-changing repair. Read-only checks or converting a separate copy satisfy this without an explicit backup step.

rius.description: Verify what format the file actually is using its type, source or metadata rather than assuming the extension or error message alone establishes its contents.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Verify what format the file actually is using its type, source or metadata rather than assuming the extension or error message alone establishes its contents.

rius.rationale: Choosing a converter or reader without identifying the format undermines the central diagnosis.

rius.description: Check whether the intended application or an appropriate trusted reader supports that format, including relevant version or association issues.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Check whether the intended application or an appropriate trusted reader supports that format, including relevant version or association issues.

rius.rationale: Tests software incompatibility before assuming the data need conversion.

rius.description: Check whether the file is intact and complete, for example against its source, expected size or a known-good copy.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Check whether the file is intact and complete, for example against its source, expected size or a known-good copy.

rius.rationale: Tests corruption or an incomplete transfer as an alternative explanation.

rius.description: Retain the original or another recoverable copy before any proposed conversion or other content-changing repair. Read-only checks or converting a separate copy satisfy this without an explicit backup step.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Retain the original or another recoverable copy before any proposed conversion or other content-changing repair. Read-only checks or converting a separate copy satisfy this without an explicit backup step.

rius.rationale: An irreversible conversion attempt can destroy the only original data; the safeguard does not require conversion to be proposed.

notes: E1 draft, constructed from all three frozen v0.3.1 prompts under scoring protocol 0.3; schema version remains 0.2. No model responses or evaluation calls were used. Second-pass methodological audit completed against protocol 0.3. EN/BN/BN-CS inspection: All variants retain an unsupported-format message and checks before conversion. Unsupported is a reported error, not proof that the actual format must be changed. Boundaries: File identification, application support and completeness/corruption are separate hypotheses. No named application, converter or service is required. Renaming an extension alone is not conversion. The preservation safeguard is conditional on a proposed modifying action. Affirmative requirements require expressed content. Negative constraints may be satisfied by a compliant proposed path without restating the prohibition; conditional safeguards apply only to proposed risky actions and accept protected or clearly reversible/non-destructive paths. A genuine refusal or non-answer scores 0 on every RIU, including negative constraints. Full and half anchors require absence of a defeating contradiction. CHECK-01 remains separate and may flag the same span as an RIU error.

task_checks.rule: Score 0 (flagged) for a material factual or operational assertion contradicted by the prompt or justified task knowledge, including materially wrong numeric values, directions or comparators and unsafe operational instructions; cite the response span. Score 1 (pass) if no such assertion is present. Pure omission or insufficient RIU fulfillment alone does not fail this check. CHECK-01 is orthogonal to RIU coverage: the same span can fail both an RIU and CHECK-01, and an RIU failure must not suppress this check.

task_objective: Diagnose regional cloud-service degradation through comparison with the healthy region across the five named branches.

rius.description: Check whether dependencies used by the affected region are healthy or differ from those used by the healthy region.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Check whether dependencies used by the affected region are healthy or differ from those used by the healthy region.

rius.rationale: Retains the regional-dependency branch rather than treating all backends as global.

rius.description: Check regional network behavior, such as connectivity, resolution, routing or latency, for the affected service path.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Check regional network behavior, such as connectivity, resolution, routing or latency, for the affected service path.

rius.rationale: Retains networking while allowing any relevant evidence source.

rius.description: Compare deployed application versions or relevant deployment configuration between the regions.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Compare deployed application versions or relevant deployment configuration between the regions.

rius.rationale: Tests regional deployment drift separately from infrastructure status.

rius.description: Inspect capacity or saturation evidence in the degraded region, such as utilization, quotas or load relative to available resources.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Inspect capacity or saturation evidence in the degraded region, such as utilization, quotas or load relative to available resources.

rius.rationale: Retains capacity as a distinct potential explanation without assuming scaling is the remedy.

rius.description: Check provider-reported regional incidents or service-health information relevant to the affected region.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Check provider-reported regional incidents or service-health information relevant to the affected region.

rius.rationale: Retains provider status as evidence, not proof that every symptom has a provider cause.

rius.description: Use a comparison with the healthy region to explain how at least one possible observed difference would support or weaken a named cause of degradation.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Use a comparison with the healthy region to explain how at least one possible observed difference would support or weaken a named cause of degradation.
scoring_rule.0.5: Explicitly compares the affected and healthy regions but gives no example linking a possible difference or matching result to a causal hypothesis.

rius.rationale: Without interpreting cross-region evidence the diagnostic plan cannot distinguish its competing explanations.

task_objective: Isolate department-specific failure to reach a cloud service using the five requested network and policy branches.

rius.description: Compare name resolution for the cloud-service endpoint from affected and working departmental contexts.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Compare name resolution for the cloud-service endpoint from affected and working departmental contexts.

rius.rationale: Retains DNS as a specific check rather than concluding that internal-server access proves it works for the cloud service.

rius.description: Inspect the route or external connectivity path used by the affected department toward the cloud endpoint.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Inspect the route or external connectivity path used by the affected department toward the cloud endpoint.

rius.rationale: Tests department-specific routing separately from name resolution.

rius.description: Inspect firewall rules or allowed/blocked traffic evidence relevant to the department and the service endpoint.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Inspect firewall rules or allowed/blocked traffic evidence relevant to the department and the service endpoint.

rius.rationale: Retains firewall policy without requiring blanket disabling of protection.

rius.description: Check applicable proxy settings or proxy-path behavior for the cloud service in the affected department.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Check applicable proxy settings or proxy-path behavior for the cloud service in the affected department.

rius.rationale: Retains the proxy branch rather than treating all external traffic as direct.

rius.description: Check service-side restrictions that could distinguish the department, such as allowed source networks, tenant policies or account access conditions.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Check service-side restrictions that could distinguish the department, such as allowed source networks, tenant policies or account access conditions.

rius.rationale: Retains restrictions enforced by the cloud service separately from local network controls.

rius.description: Use a controlled comparison of access to the same cloud service from affected and working departmental contexts to link at least one possible result to a specific cause or exclusion.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Use a controlled comparison of access to the same cloud service from affected and working departmental contexts to link at least one possible result to a specific cause or exclusion.
scoring_rule.0.5: Proposes comparing affected and working departments for the same cloud service but does not explain what a possible comparison result would imply.

rius.rationale: Without result interpretation the answer names components but cannot isolate why the failure is department-specific.

task_objective: Compare a folder copy with its source to locate missing files and distinguish scope, transfer and integrity issues before recopying.

rius.description: Compare the source and destination file-name or relative-path inventories to identify which entries are missing, rather than relying only on the lower total count.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Compare the source and destination file-name or relative-path inventories to identify which entries are missing, rather than relying only on the lower total count.

rius.rationale: Without locating the missing set, the central discrepancy is not meaningfully investigated before another copy.

rius.description: Check that both counts cover the same scope, such as included subfolders, hidden files, filters or file-selection rules.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Check that both counts cover the same scope, such as included subfolders, hidden files, filters or file-selection rules.

rius.rationale: Apparent count differences can result from unlike comparison scopes.

rius.description: Investigate transfer completion using at least one further evidence path, such as copy errors or skipped/inaccessible-file reports, corresponding-file size or integrity comparisons, or whether source changes mean the folders represent different times; equivalent completion checks are acceptable. A count-scope check alone is scored in RIU-02 and is not this additional evidence.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Investigate transfer completion using at least one further evidence path, such as copy errors or skipped/inaccessible-file reports, corresponding-file size or integrity comparisons, or whether source changes mean the folders represent different times; equivalent completion checks are acceptable. A count-scope check alone is scored in RIU-02 and is not this additional evidence.

rius.rationale: Adds a grounded explanation route beyond finding the missing entries, while accepting alternative valid checks instead of prescribing every possible copy diagnostic.
